# descope_google_cloud_translation_connector (Resource)

Manages a Google Cloud Translation connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Localize the language of your login and user journey screens with the Google Cloud Translation connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_project_id` (String) The Google Cloud project ID where the Google Cloud Translation is managed.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `service_account_json` (String, Sensitive) Service Account JSON associated with the current project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
